title: UzEngine Animation Controller
description: UzEngine animation controller file (.uzanimcontroller) — state machine and blend tree for skeletal animation blending. Defines states, transitions with blend times, 1D/2D blend trees, and animation layers with masks.

skeleton.description: Path to the skeleton asset (.uzskeleton) this controller is built for.

parameters.description: Runtime parameters that drive state transitions and blend tree weights. Set from gameplay code via ctx.animator:set_parameter().

name.description: Parameter name referenced by transitions and blend nodes.

type.description: Parameter data type. 'trigger' auto-resets to false after consumed by a transition.

default.description: Default value. Must match the declared type.

layers.description: Animation layers evaluated in order. Each layer has its own state machine and optional bone mask. Layer 0 is the base layer.

blend_mode.description: How this layer combines with layers below. 'override' replaces. 'additive' adds deltas.

weight.description: Layer blend weight. 0 = fully transparent, 1 = fully applied.

bone_mask.description: Bone names affected by this layer. If omitted, all bones are affected. Used for upper/lower body splits.

default_state.description: Name of the initial state when the controller starts. Defaults to the first state.

states.description: State machine states. Each state plays an animation or evaluates a blend tree.

transitions.description: Directed transitions between states, triggered by parameter conditions.

name.description: Unique state name within this layer.

type.description: State type. 'clip' plays a single animation. 'blend_tree_1d/2d' blends multiple clips by parameter.

animation.description: Path to animation sequence (.uzanimsequence). Used when type is 'clip'.

speed.description: Playback speed multiplier. Negative values play in reverse.

loop.description: Whether the animation loops. One-shot states (attacks, reactions) set this to false.

blend_tree.description: Blend tree definition. Used when type is 'blend_tree_1d' or 'blend_tree_2d'.

position.description: Editor canvas position [x, y] for visual layout.

parameter.description: Parameter name driving the blend (must be a float parameter). For 2D, this is the X axis.

parameter_y.description: Second parameter for 2D blend trees (Y axis). Only used when parent state type is 'blend_tree_2d'.

entries.description: Blend entries positioned along the parameter axis. Runtime interpolates between the two nearest entries.

threshold.description: Position on the blend axis. For 1D: scalar value. For 2D: X coordinate.

speed.description: Playback speed multiplier for this entry.

from.description: Source state name. Use '*' for 'any state' transitions.

offset.description: Normalized start offset in the destination animation [0..1].

interruption.description: Whether this transition can be interrupted by another. 'current' = by source state's transitions, 'next' = by destination's.

conditions.description: All conditions must be true for the transition to fire (AND logic).

value.description: Comparison value. Not required for 'true'/'false' comparisons.

has_exit_time.description: If true, transition only fires after the source animation reaches exit_time.

exit_time.description: Normalized time [0..1] in source animation at which exit is allowed. 1.0 = end of animation.
